findings.title: DarkBlinders: Inside an Active Espionage Campaign
findings.summary_md: Dream Research Labs disclosed an active DarkBlinders espionage campaign running August to October 2026 against Israel and the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. Operators used government webmail, cloud-drive, and meeting-service lures including the fake StarkMeet video-meeting app, plus GitHub repositories under the PeakyBlindersTeam account for command and control. The investigation confirmed compromise of a high-profile Israeli individual and a government cloud environment in Kurdistan, with roughly ten distinct hosts in available check-in data. Researchers accessed GitHub read-only and did not issue commands to any malware instance.

findings.title: Blinder Tunnel Campaign Targets Iraqi Infrastructure
findings.summary_md: Unit 42 tracked CL-STA-1178, an Iran-aligned actor, in the Blinder Tunnel campaign against Iraqi critical infrastructure in March 2026 with infrastructure staging from November 2025. Attackers masqueraded as Dubai Airports IT recruiters delivering trojanized coding challenges, using AppDomainManager hijacking and DLL sideloading, and abused GitHub API for command and control including an in-memory Chisel tunnel. The same actor used conflict-themed Google Drive lures against an Israeli entity in May to June 2026. Dream Research later linked DarkBlinders to this Unit 42-documented activity.

findings.title: DarkBlinders APT: Aviation and Telecom Espionage in UAE
findings.summary_md: Group-IB profiled DarkBlinders as an Iran-nexus intrusion set active since September 2024 targeting aviation in the UAE and telecoms in Iraq including the Kurdistan Region, with seven confirmed victims across two countries. The group used spear-phishing with trojanized utilities and credential-harvesting portals, abused GitHub infrastructure for command and control with a Peaky Blinders theme, and showed an 8 out of 10 TTP evolution score within under two years. Group-IB assessed the observed phase as likely retired or evolved into a new arsenal with no technical overlap.
